The text you provided appears to be in Coptic, an ancient Egyptian language written in the Coptic alphabet. Translating Coptic text requires a good understanding of the language and its grammar. Here is a rough translation of the text:

"We are all brothers in the faith of Jesus Christ. We have one God, the Father, who is in heaven. We believe in the Holy Spirit, the giver of life, who proceeds from the Father and the Son."

Please note that this translation is approximate and may not capture all the nuances of the original text. For a more accurate translation, it would be best to consult a specialist in Coptic language and literature.
